summary: # UV Editor Tutorial for Marvelous Designer Welcome to the quick start tutorial on UV in Marvelous Designer. In this guide, we will cover the essential steps for utilizing UVs effectively in your garment design. ## Getting Started To use UVs, we must first have a garment in the scene. We will use a basic T-shirt from the default garment files. ## Activating the UV Editor To activate the UVs window, follow these steps: 1. Navigate to the Windows browser of one of the main windows. 2. Choose **UV Editor**. When a pattern is selected in the 2D window, it is also selected in the UV Editor window. This feature helps you easily identify your patterns, especially if they are not correctly distributed yet. ## Context Menu and Functions Right-clicking will display a pop-up menu with functions used to align or edit the position of the patterns. The available functions include: - **Align**: Offers different options to structure your UVs, allowing you to adjust them to horizontal or vertical lines. - **Fit UV to 0 to 1**: Distributes your UVs in a specific tile. ## UV Editor Toolbar In the UV Editor, you will find a toolbar with four different tools: 1. **Snapshot**: Allows you to export a snapshot of your UVs to the target folder, with adjustable resolution. 2. **Bake**: Creates the selected maps at the desired resolution for the garments at the target tile. 3. **Move UVs**: Used to adjust the distance between patterns and the space that will be covered. 4. **UV Packing**: Helps you adjust your UVs with the right parameters for the selected tile. You can select the padding space for the patterns using the **Packing Ratio**, and the target tile can be adjusted as well. ### Tools Accessibility The **Bake Texture** and **UV Packing** tools can be accessed from anywhere within the application. Both tools maintain the same properties for editing. ## Adjusting UVs If you need to distribute your UVs across different tiles, you can use the **Move** tool to adjust the selected patterns to a specific distance. ### Pattern Creation To create a new pattern: - Drag the pattern into the UV Crawl. - Change the size of your pattern as needed. In the UV view, you can see the pattern connected to the **UV Editor**. The pattern is listed as such in the UV view. To start the pattern creation process, use the cherry icon available in the UV view. ## Conclusion This quick start tutorial provides the foundational steps for utilizing the UV Editor in Marvelous Designer. Familiarizing yourself with these tools will enhance your workflow and improve your garment design process.
